researchQuestion: Why do some patients with rheumatoid arthritis respond differently to anti-TNF therapy, and which biomarkers or immune mechanisms are best supported for defining those subgroups?

hypothesisCards.label: TNF-centric framing of RA synovial inflammation and anti-TNF benefit
hypothesisCards.statusRationale: Seed pathway supports TNF as a contributory RA inflammatory axis and anti-TNF + MTX clinical benefit (RA-001/003/006/012). Response heterogeneity itself remains open — supported pathway ≠ uniform response prediction.

literatureTests.prompt: Map which retained claims under the TNF-centric frame survive expert Gate C without overclaiming tissue specificity (esp. macrophage→TNF PMID 2993897 vs RA synovial histology).
Reconcile ATTRACT / Lipsky combo-therapy background (PMID 10622295 / 11087881) with the response-heterogeneity question — keep benefit evidence separate from subgroup predictors.

hypothesisCards.label: Multi-cytokine / IL-6 axis framing (including anti-TNF inadequate responders)
hypothesisCards.statusRationale: IL-6 contributes to RA inflammatory tone (RA-004) and anti-TNF inadequate responders can still benefit from IL-6R blockade in trial populations (RA-005, PMID 18625622). Framing is supported as a competing axis; causal universality stays uncertain (teaching=hypothesized on RA-005).

literatureTests.prompt: Re-check S-P-O for RA-005: related_axis (anti-TNF inadequate responders → IL-6R blockade) vs any stronger causal map — curator must reject silent promotion before Gate C.
List what additional public literature would be required to harden (or refute) IL-6-axis enrichment among inadequate anti-TNF responders — research mapping only, not a protocol to enrol patients.

hypothesisCards.label: ADA / immunogenicity framing (anti-drug antibodies and bioavailability)
hypothesisCards.statusRationale: Infliximab ADA / trough literature anchors secondary non-response via immunogenicity (RA-007/008; PMID 16508927 / 17133559). Supported as a competing frame — agent generalisation and partner monitoring scope remain open (gap adjacent).

literatureTests.prompt: Annotate which ADA / trough claims are infliximab-weighted and must not be over-generalised to all anti-TNF agents at Gate C (seeds already flag this).
With the future named partner: decide whether ADA / trough monitoring is in-scope for the Stage 1 question or deferred — literature anchors only until then.

hypothesisCards.label: Serologic subgroup framing (RF / ACPA) — association claimed vs not supported
hypothesisCards.statusRationale: Contested serology frame: Potter cohort association (RA-009, PMID 18375541) vs Lv meta-analysis no reliable RF/ACPA response prediction (RA-010, PMID 24586782). Workup biomarker role (RA-002/011) is separate. Status=gap until expert decides inclusion-axis vs background context — not a silent predictor.

literatureTests.prompt: Keep RA-009 vs RA-010 disagreement visible in any brief: document what each PMID does and does not support for anti-TNF response prediction.
Clarify with partner whether RF/ACPA status is an inclusion axis for the research question or only background serology (LOINC 53031-9 / 11572-5) — do not invent predictive CDS rules.

hypothesisCards.label: RF/ACPA status as a reliable predictor of clinical response to anti-TNF (strong predictive claim)
hypothesisCards.statusRationale: Lv et al. meta-analysis (PMID 24586782 / RA-010) does not support RF or anti-CCP as a reliable anti-TNF response predictor. Potter cohort association (RA-009) remains visible as contested observational signal — not sufficient to keep the strong predictive claim as supported.

literatureTests.prompt: Treat 'reliable predictor' language as refuted for Stage 1 synthesis unless new partner-licensed evidence overturns PMID 24586782 — retain RA-009 as contested association only.

rankedGaps.title: RF/ACPA response-prediction disagreement remains unresolved
rankedGaps.why: RA-009 (association) vs RA-010 (meta-analysis no reliable prediction) must stay visible; predictive claim is treated as refuted for synthesis.
rankedGaps.nextExperimentPrompt: Produce a one-page literature reconciliation note citing PMID 18375541 and 24586782 only — flag what would overturn the 'not a reliable predictor' stance without inventing new PMIDs.

rankedGaps.title: IL-6-axis enrichment among anti-TNF inadequate responders needs sharper mapping
rankedGaps.why: Working hypothesis hyp-ra-response-het + RA-005 remain hypothesized/uncertain; competing TNF-only narratives must not be collapsed.
rankedGaps.nextExperimentPrompt: Evidence-map public literature that strengthens or weakens IL-6 enrichment among inadequate anti-TNF responders, anchored to PMID 18625622 claim IDs — research brief, not a patient enrolment protocol.

rankedGaps.nextExperimentPrompt: Draft a scope-decision checklist for ADA/trough (infliximab-weighted PMIDs 16508927 / 17133559) — include / defer / out-of-scope — for named-partner confirmation.
